import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette for survival
survival_palette = {0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'}
survival_labels = {0: 'Did not survive', 1: 'Survived'}

# Plot 1: Survival rate by passenger class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#3498db', '#e91e63'], edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticklabels(['1st Class', '2nd Class', '3rd Class'], rotation=0)
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)
for container in ax1.containers:
    ax1.bar_label(container, fmt='%.2f', fontsize=9)

# Plot 2: Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
for survived in [0, 1]:
    subset = df_age[df_age['survived'] == survived]
    ax2.hist(subset['age'], bins=30, alpha=0.6, label=survival_labels[survived], 
             color=survival_palette[survived], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Outcome')

# Plot 3: Survival by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embark_town')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
embark_survival['not_survived'] = embark_survival['count'] - embark_survival['sum']
embark_survival = embark_survival.dropna()
embark_survival = embark_survival.sort_values('count', ascending=True)

bar_width = 0.6
y_pos = range(len(embark_survival))
ax3.barh(y_pos, embark_survival['not_survived'], bar_width, 
         label='Did not survive', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black')
ax3.barh(y_pos, embark_survival['sum'], bar_width, 
         left=embark_survival['not_survived'], label='Survived', color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax3.set_yticklabels(embark_survival.index)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Passengers', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Survival by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Outcome', loc='lower right')

# Plot 4: Fare vs Age colored by survival with class markers
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df_plot = df.dropna(subset=['age', 'fare'])
scatter = ax4.scatter(df_plot['age'], df_plot['fare'], 
                      c=df_plot['survived'].map(survival_palette), 
                      alpha=0.6, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5, s=50)

# Create custom legend for survival
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#2ecc71', 
                          markersize=10, label='Survived'),
                   Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#e74c3c', 
                          markersize=10, label='Did not survive')]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, title='Outcome', loc='upper right')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Fare vs Age by Survival Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)  # Limit y-axis to better show distribution

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
